# Pre-launch audit: Ledgerly (saas-app) I audited four files: `index.html`, `imprint.html`, `app/dashboard.html` and `robots.txt`. ## Established defects 1. **`index.html`: script loaded over insecure HTTP (mixed content).** - Evidence: `` - On an HTTPS site, browsers block this active mixed content, so the widget will not load. If it did load, it could be tampered with in transit. Use an `https://` URL. 2. **`index.html`: no viewport meta tag.** - Evidence: the `` has only `charset`, `title`, `description` and the script. `imprint.html` does include ``. - Mobile browsers will render the landing page at desktop width. 3. **`app/dashboard.html`: missing `lang` attribute and viewport meta tag.** - Evidence: the page opens with `` (no `lang`), and the `` contains only `charset` and `title`. - This hurts screen-reader pronunciation and language detection, and the page will not render responsively on mobile. 4. **`index.html` and `app/dashboard.html`: images have no `alt` attribute.** - Evidence: - `index.html`: `` - `app/dashboard.html`: `` and `` - Screen-reader users get no description. Use meaningful alt text for informative images and `alt=""` for decorative ones. 5. **`app/dashboard.html`: the title is copied from the marketing homepage, and there is no meta description.** - Evidence: `Ledgerly — close your books faster` is identical to the title in `index.html`, while the page's `

` is "Dashboard". - The title does not describe the page, and the two pages are indistinguishable in tabs, history and bookmarks. A title such as "Dashboard — Ledgerly" would fix this. - The page is disallowed in `robots.txt`, so the missing description is low priority. 6. **`imprint.html`: placeholder content.** - Evidence: `

Imprint

`, while the meta description promises "Company details and the responsible contact." - The page has no company name, address or contact. An imprint page without these fails its legal purpose in jurisdictions that require one. 7. **`imprint.html` is not linked from any supplied page.** - Evidence: the only link in the site files is `index.html` → `/app/dashboard.html`. Nothing links to `/imprint.html`. - A legal page must be easy to reach. Add a footer link on the landing page and in the app. 8. **Site-wide: no sitemap.** - Evidence: `/sitemap.xml` is absent from the supplied files, and `robots.txt` has no `Sitemap:` directive. - This is minor for a site this small, but it should be added or consciously skipped. 9. **Site-wide: no favicon.** - Evidence: `/favicon.ico` is absent, and no page has a ``. - Browsers will request `/favicon.ico` and get a 404, and the tab will show no brand icon. ## Uncertainties (not counted as defects) - **Referenced assets are not in the supplied files:** `/product-screenshot.png`, `/icons/chart.svg` and `/icons/export.svg`. They may exist outside this snapshot. Confirm they are deployed, or the images will be broken. - **`cdn.ledgerly.example/widget.js`:** I can't verify that the host serves HTTPS. - **Privacy policy and terms pages:** none are supplied. A SaaS product normally needs them, but I can't tell whether they are meant to be part of this deployment. - **`robots.txt` blocks `/app/`:** this looks intentional. It is not access control, so confirm the app requires authentication. `index.html` also links directly to `/app/dashboard.html`, and the dashboard HTML contains no sign of an auth gate.
